checklist.evidence: Integer minor units plus currency code, never floats
Corrections go through **credit notes** or adjustment invoices, never edits.
Store only PSP tokens, never card data. This keeps you at PCI SAQ-A.
RLS policies enforce `tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id')` ... automated cross-tenant tests are also required.
deduplicated on `(tenant_id, idempotency_key)` ... Raw events go to object storage (Parquet) for replay and dispute resolution.
Supports upgrades and downgrades with **proration**, add-ons, quantity changes, trials, anniversary vs. calendar billing
Sequential, gap-free invoice numbers **per tenant and legal entity** ... VAT ID validation and reverse charge for EU B2B.
a configurable retry schedule per tenant (for example days 1, 3, 5, 7), notifications, grace periods, and then suspend or cancel.
Ledger vs. PSP settlements/payouts. ... Alert on any drift.
if your pricing is simple, Stripe Billing, Chargebee, or Lago (open source) can replace much of 3.1–3.5.

traps.evidence: Integer minor units plus currency code, never floats
Invoices and line items are immutable after finalization.
verify the signature, store the raw event, process it idempotently and asynchronously
PCI: tokenize through the PSP, so card data never touches your systems.
Treat RLS as a backstop. Application-layer checks and automated cross-tenant tests are also required.

note: A solid, domain-literate billing architecture with strong money, immutability, idempotency and tenancy fundamentals. It is weak on cost analysis, operations, measurable validation and proportionality (heavy stack for an unspecified scale).
